english: You know these sharks now. Here they really are — real photographs and footage of the animals you tagged and released, hand-picked for this archive. A few entries also include credited historical or scientific illustrations.
quebec_french: Tu connais maintenant ces requins dans le jeu. Découvre-les dans la vraie vie grâce à des photos et des vidéos soigneusement sélectionnées de leurs espèces. Certaines fiches présentent aussi des illustrations historiques ou scientifiques, avec leurs sources.
notes: Mira 2026-10-21 (IMPORTANT, species-vs-individual honesty): draft implied photos were of the player's very individual; Archive shows the same SPECIES, generally not the tagged individual. English original has the same misreading — flagged for the English game too.
Sort uses taggedAt timestamp, not the display date string (same safeguard as Logbook).
Uses Batch 2 UICN, not IUCN, in French.
Mira 2026-10-21: 'nouvelle photo' only if the badge is photo-only; its trigger was not confirmed photo-only, so the broader 'nouveau média' is safer. Alternatives: 'nouveau contenu'.
Followed by nickname (if any) + research ID + tagged date/location.

Mira 2026-10-21: 'marqué le {date} à {location}' is ungrammatical with regions like Mer des Caraïbes / Eaux arctiques. Location-neutral form. Date from taggedAt fr-CA + region label from region key at build time (see plan obligations).
Badge title; status names themselves are in the Research batch.

english: 📸 Wild media coming soon — being curated.
quebec_french: 📸 Images à venir — sélection en cours.
notes: Mira 2026-10-21: 'Médias sauvages bientôt disponibles' sounded like the media were feral; 'Images' covers photos, videos AND illustrations, which the Archive includes.
Used instead of © for public-domain / CC0 assets.

Mira 2026-10-21: 'extrait de l'original' was vague; verified — the trimmed:true assets are videos with clip boundaries (lemon, whitetip), so the video wording is accurate. Preserve that a selected segment is shown.
Proper name, kept as-is; default source label.
